finding.message: An account name is interpolated into a command the module runs at import.

reason: Reclassified from an abstention to a static assertion on 2026-09-27. The sink still runs at import on a value no test can set, so the proof is still refused as module_scope_source_not_controllable and no regression test can fail on this code before a repair and pass after one; what changed is that a refused proof is no longer the end of the road. The deterministic template repair for this site is now asserted at the static_assertion level instead, which is why the fixture asserts a repair at exactly that level rather than an abstention: keeping the abstention would have asserted that the engine ships nothing here, which is no longer true, and the corpus would have been testing a claim the product had stopped making.
